title: Epimorphism
description: JSON Schema for an epimorphism — a morphism f : A → B that is right-cancellable: g ∘ f = h ∘ f implies g = h for every parallel pair g, h : B → Y (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. I §5; Awodey 2010 §2.1). The categorical generalization of surjectivity; in Set the epimorphisms are exactly the surjections. Dual to monomorphism. Specializes transformer by structural property; the cancellability law is universally quantified.
